in_sanskrit.name: सामिर
in_sanskrit.meaning: समीरणम् (samīraṇam) - To touch, to feel, to explore
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who touches or feels, or the one who explores. This name is derived from the root word ‘sam’ meaning 'together' and ‘mira’ meaning 'touch'. It is often given to babies who are expected to explore and learn about the world around them with curiosity and enthusiasm.
